exam.title: Configuring and Operating Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop
exam.study_prerequisites: Azure administration plus Windows desktop/server, virtualization, Microsoft Entra ID and AD DS, Group Policy or Intune, networking, SMB and Kerberos, storage, profiles, application delivery, security, monitoring, scripting, backup, and disaster-recovery experience.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure
Plan and implement identity and security
Plan and implement user environments and apps
Monitor and maintain an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

review.notes: All four weighted July 20, 2026 objective groups and their published subobjectives are mapped to an end-to-end connection and state-delivery model, implementation decisions, failure modes, three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 24 original knowledge checks. All 27 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries; two O'Reilly pages and one Udemy page returned HTTP 403 and are treated as access-blocked rather than missing. The guide includes current RDP Shortpath and Multipath, Private Link, Entra SSO and dual Conditional Access evaluation, App Attach, FSLogix, Trusted Launch/confidential VM, Insights, Autoscale, immutable image and multi-region recovery topics. OS/client support, licensing, RDP rollout, identity/storage constraints, security defaults, SKUs, limits, pricing, and preview/retirement-sensitive behavior are explicitly marked VERIFY CURRENT.

findings.evidence: Current feature list includes autoscale/start/update; App Attach has an exception and future enforcement date is unspecified.

findings.resolution: Replace universal service-principal wording with feature-specific identity and authorization guidance.

findings.title: Management approach is fixed when the pool is created
findings.evidence: Session-host configuration is pooled-only and excludes external standard-management host tooling.
findings.recommendation: Add creation-time choice and operational ownership comparison.
findings.resolution: Add creation-time choice and operational ownership comparison.

findings.title: Host replacement does not retain all state or telemetry
findings.evidence: Update replaces VMs, affects AD trust, requires autoscale coordination and does not automatically install AMA.
findings.recommendation: Add capacity/state/monitoring and actual rollback validation.
findings.resolution: Add capacity/state/monitoring and actual rollback validation.

findings.title: Hybrid does not inherit all Azure VM lifecycle features
findings.evidence: Current overview excludes client multi-session, autoscale, Start VM on Connect and session-host configuration.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded architecture comparison and explicit unsupported assumptions.
findings.resolution: Add bounded architecture comparison and explicit unsupported assumptions.

findings.title: Multipath availability depends on client and cloud
findings.evidence: Government redundant TCP phased, macOS UDP Beta, different Windows client prerequisites.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped status and distinguish standby resilience from aggregate bandwidth.
findings.resolution: Add scoped status and distinguish standby resilience from aggregate bandwidth.

findings.title: Cloud-only profile support has a specific authentication boundary
findings.evidence: Current build/cloud/tenant requirements and silent storage-app MFA exception differ from broad account eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add role/ACL/consent/source checks and preserve AVD MFA scope.
findings.resolution: Add role/ACL/consent/source checks and preserve AVD MFA scope.

findings.title: Profile reliability depends on supported FSLogix and storage authentication
findings.evidence: 26.08 adds ticket refresh without changing ten-hour ticket lifetime and includes stability/security fixes.
findings.recommendation: Add versioned long-session/reconnect acceptance and current hardening checks.
findings.resolution: Add versioned long-session/reconnect acceptance and current hardening checks.

findings.title: Short cache timeout is not proof of remote data durability
findings.evidence: Provider and forced-unregister/cache-deletion choices can discard unflushed state.
findings.recommendation: Add recovery boundary and original flush-time estimate.
findings.resolution: Add recovery boundary and original flush-time estimate.

findings.title: Old Windows client support differs by distribution/cloud
findings.evidence: Public MSI ended March 27; limited extension ends September 28; Store app ended in 2025.

findings.title: Classic Teams and WebRTC optimization have separate lifecycles
findings.evidence: Dedicated classic page ends availability July 2025; scoped VDI announcement covers Windows WebRTC October 2026/April 2027.
